title: xgboost_cv_summary.json
description: Schema template for the CV summary written by scripts/03_train_xgboost.py.

n_splits.description: Number of stratified CV folds. Default: 5.

random_state.description: Seed used for fold assignment and PINN initialisation.

feature_columns.description: Feature columns fed to XGBoost in this run.

fold_metrics.description: Per-fold metric panel at the fold's locally-selected decision threshold.

oof_metrics.description: Metric panel on the pooled OOF predictions at the OOF-selected threshold.

decision_threshold_from_oof.description: Threshold selected on pooled OOF predictions.

final_n_estimators_from_cv.description: Mean (rounded) of the per-fold best n_estimators.

pinn_fold_summaries.description: Per-fold PINN fit summaries when the feature preset uses PINN; null otherwise.
